Priority Order
sections.content:
| Priority | Issue | File | Impact |
|---|---|---|---|
| P0 | N+1 upserts in payroll processing | `api/payroll/[id]/process/route.ts` | Scales linearly with employee count |
| P0 | Missing indexes on `status`, `date` | `schema.prisma` | Full table scans on every list/count |
| P1 | Missing AbortController on all fetches | 4 client pages | Stale data, wasted requests |
| P1 | Sequential validation queries in leaves POST | `api/leaves/route.ts` | Doubled latency |
| P2 | Dashboard queries uncached | `page.tsx` | Repeated DB hits on navigation |
| P2 | Pool not tuned | `lib/prisma.ts` | Connection exhaustion under load |
| P3 | Full refetch on single-record updates | `attendance/page.tsx` | Unnecessary re-renders |
| P3 | Payroll totals recomputed each render | `payroll/page.tsx` | Minor CPU waste |
